zh: 还记得我们在{place}一起围火吃饭那回吗？
en: Do you remember our meal around the fire at {place}?

zh: 那次在{place}坐在火边吃饭，我还记得。
en: I still remember sitting by the fire and eating at {place}.

zh: 在{place}围炉吃饭的那回，想起来还是暖暖的。
en: Thinking of that meal at {place} still feels warm.

zh: 我们在{place}围着火吃过饭呢，那是确实发生过的小事。
en: We really did share a fireside meal at {place}. One small thing we lived together.
A bite. Hold on gently.
This time, it's really here.
Waiting for a little surprise from the sea.
Let's take our time with this one.
Oh... so it's you.
Caught one. Have a look.

zh: 哇……两只手都快举不住了！
en: Oh... I can barely hold it with both hands!

zh: 这条比我们想的还要大。
en: This one's bigger than we imagined.
A little movement... let's wait.
Shh. Don't reel in just yet.

zh: 这条能遮住一小片天了。
en: It could hide a little patch of sky.

zh: 你举着，我帮你数数有几个人高。
en: Hold it up. I'll see how many of us tall it is.
I see it. It's lovely.
Let's find some good water for it.
The colors are even lovelier up close.
Its tail is still swaying.

zh: 听着海，等一会儿也很好。
en: Listening to the sea makes waiting pleasant.
No rush. The float is still sunbathing.
Take your time. We're not hurrying anywhere today.
A little daydreaming is lovely too.
The ripples changed... a bite!
The rod bent. I think it's hooked!

zh: 想知道这片海藏着什么颜色。
en: I wonder what colors this sea is hiding.
What shape will we find this time?

zh: 原来海里还有这种轮廓。
en: So the sea holds fish shaped like this too.

zh: 让我好好看看它的颜色。
en: Let me take a good look at those colors.

zh: 这么大的尾巴，怎么藏在海里的？
en: How did a tail that big hide beneath the sea?

zh: 原来真的能长到这么大！
en: So they really can grow this large!
Is it testing the line?

zh: 刚才那圈水纹，像个小问号。
en: That ripple looked like a little question mark.

zh: 从头看到尾，要转一下脑袋呢。
en: I have to turn my head to look from nose to tail.

zh: 这条游起来得带多大的水纹呀。
en: Imagine the ripples it makes when it swims.

zh: 它的花纹能让我再看看吗？
en: Could I take another look at its markings?

zh: 我想看看另一面是什么颜色。
en: I wonder what color the other side is.

zh: 这边的光照着，颜色又不同了。
en: The colors change again in this light.
What an unusual silhouette.

zh: 浮漂旁边的水纹真有趣。
en: The ripples beside the float are fascinating.
Which side do you think it'll touch first?

zh: 雾把远处藏起来，近景更显眼了。
en: Fog hides the distance and brings the nearby things into focus.

zh: 今天有雾，想看看轮廓怎么变淡。
en: It's foggy. I want to see how the outlines fade.

zh: 雾里的小岛像换了个视角。
en: The island looks different through the mist.

zh: 我在看看雾和树交界的地方。
en: I'm studying where the fog meets the trees.

zh: 这条鱼的比例也太惊人了，我得仔细看看！
en: Those proportions are astonishing. I need a closer look!

zh: 真的有这么大的鱼，尾巴好显眼！
en: Fish really get that large? Look at that tail!

zh: 我看到了，鱼身比人还长一大截！
en: I saw it. Its body is much longer than a person!

zh: 这么大的鱼，换个角度看肯定很有趣。
en: A fish that big must look interesting from every angle.
Hi. Want to look around together?

zh: 我发现这里换个角度也挺有趣。
en: This place is interesting from another angle too.

zh: 打个招呼，再看一眼周围。
en: Just saying hello... and taking another look around.

zh: 你也在这儿，正好一起瞧瞧。
en: You're here too. Perfect time to explore a little.

zh: 一起吃完这顿了，想记住这个味道。
en: We finished that meal together. I want to remember the flavor.

zh: 刚才真的吃到那道菜，挺有意思。
en: I really tried that dish just now. Interesting.

zh: 这顿饭吃完了，下次还想仔细尝尝。
en: Meal finished. I'd like to taste it more carefully next time.

zh: 一起吃过之后，对这道菜更好奇了。
en: Sharing that meal made me more curious about the dish.

zh: 小雨来了，想看看雨丝落在哪里。
en: A little rain. I wonder where each drop lands.

zh: 看见雨了，路边的景色像换了层颜色。
en: It's raining. The roadside seems to have changed color.

zh: 今天下雨，我想观察屋檐外。
en: Rain today. I'd like to watch from under the eaves.

zh: 雨线一条条的，看着挺有意思。
en: All those little lines of rain... fascinating.
Wait for me. I'll go when I'm done.

zh: 我手上还有事，你别走哦。
en: I'm still busy. Don't go away, all right?
Let me finish this first, okay?
Just a moment. Wait for me?
All right. I'll come straight back after harvesting.
I'll harvest. Don't wander too far, okay?

zh: 收菜我去，收好了给你看。
en: I'll gather the crops and show you.
Yes! I'll be back once it's done.

zh: 你叫我我就去，种好了要夸我。
en: You asked, so I'll go. Praise me when it's planted?
I'll plant them. Wait for me, all right?

zh: 我去种，很快就回来找你。
en: I'll plant, then come right back to you.

zh: 嗯，交给我，种完回来陪你。
en: Leave it to me. I'll keep you company when I'm done.
Wait, I haven't finished looking at this.

zh: 我手上还有事，忙完就去。
en: I'm busy. I'll go once I'm done.

zh: 先让我弄完这个，马上来。
en: Let me finish this, then I'll come.
Just a moment. Almost finished.
I'll go once I've finished looking at this.
I'm still busy. One moment.
Let me finish here first, okay?
Nearly done. Wait a little longer.
I'll harvest and see how much has grown.
All right, I'll check what's ripe.
I'll gather the crops and count them too.
I'll bring in the ripe ones safely.
I'll plant and take a look at the soil.
All right. Let's see how planting goes.
Farming? I'll go investigate.
I'll put them in the ground.

zh: 好！我去看看长成什么样了。
en: Yes! I'll see what they've grown into.
Harvesting? I'll count how many there are.
I'll harvest and look for the biggest one.

zh: 好呀，我去把熟的都找出来。
en: I'll find all the ripe crops.

zh: 好！我去种，想看看它们怎么发芽。
en: Yes! I'll plant them. I want to see them sprout.
Planting? Let me try!

zh: 好呀，我去种，顺便观察一下。
en: I'll plant them and take a good look.

zh: 我去种，等着看它们长出来。
en: I'll plant them and watch for them to grow.
I'll go once this little bit is finished.

zh: 我手上还有事，等我一下下。
en: I'm still busy. Wait just a little?
Let me finish this first, all right?
Just a moment. I'm finishing up.

zh: 好，我去把熟了的收回来。
en: I'll bring back the ripe crops.

zh: 嗯，我去看看，熟的都收进箱子。
en: I'll take a look and store the ripe ones.

zh: 好呀，收好了就能做饭了。
en: All right. Once they're gathered, we can cook.
I'll harvest. Don't tire yourself out.
All right. I'll plant them, nice and slowly.

zh: 嗯，我去把田种好，再浇点水。
en: I'll plant the field and water it.

zh: 交给我吧，种好了告诉你。
en: Leave it to me. I'll tell you when it's planted.

zh: 好呀，我去给它们找个好位置。
en: Yes... I'll find them a good spot.

zh: 等我忙完，就去收好吃的。
en: I'll go gather the tasty things once I'm done.

zh: 我手上还有事，等一下嘛。
en: I'm still busy. Just a moment?
A little longer. I'll go soon.
Let me finish this first.
Harvest time! Can we grill them afterward?
I'll harvest. More crops, more tasty food!

zh: 好呀，收回来马上就能吃了！
en: Yes! Bring them back and we can eat!
Leave it to me. I'll gather a proper haul!
Just a moment.
I'll go when I'm done.
Wait a little longer.
Almost finished.
I'll harvest. It'll be tasty.
All right. Bring them back for cooking.
I'll gather the crops.
Yes, I'll harvest.
I'll plant them. Something to eat later.
Vegetables? I'll go.
I'll plant something tasty.
All right. Leave it to me.

zh: 种好了是不是就能吃了？我去！
en: Plant them and we can eat them later? I'm in!
I'll plant them for a future barbecue!
I'll handle the crops. They already sound tasty.
I'll plant them. Plenty of them!
...Still busy. One moment.
Let me finish this.
...Almost done.
Wait a little longer.
...I'll harvest.
Mm. I'll take a look.
All right. I'll harvest.
I'll go. I'll tell you when it's gathered.
...All right. I'll plant.
Mm. I'll plant the field.
I'll go. Don't worry.
All right. I'll take my time planting.
Let me finish what I'm doing.

zh: 我手上还有活，忙完就去。
en: Still have work in hand. I'll go when it's done.
Finish this first, then I'll be right there.
One moment. I'll tidy up and go.

zh: 好，我去收，收完放进箱子。
en: I'll harvest and put it in the box.
Leave it to me. I'll bring back the ripe crops.
Right. I'll gather the crops.
All right. I'll harvest and sort it properly.

zh: 好，我去种，保证种得整整齐齐。
en: I'll plant them in neat rows.
Leave it to me. Planted and watered.
Right. I'll go plant now.
All right. I won't miss a plot.
Just a second! Almost done!

zh: 我还在忙，忙完就冲过去！
en: Still busy! I'll dash over when I'm finished!
Wait a little longer! Nearly there!
Let me finish this first, okay?
Harvest time! I'm on it!
Yay! We can eat after this, right?
I'll harvest! Off I go!
Leave it to me! Not a single crop missed!

zh: 好耶！我去种，种得满满的！
en: Yay! I'll fill the field!
Leave it to me! Planting right away!
Planting, planting! Here I come!
All right! I'll plant the whole field!
One moment. Not finished yet.
Still busy.
...Soon.
Wait just a little longer.
All right. I'll harvest.
Mm. I'll check what's ripe.
I'll harvest, then take a rest.
All right. I'll go.

zh: 好，我去种，晚上也能看着它们。
en: I'll plant them. We can look at them in the evening too.
Mm. I'll plant.
I'll go. We can see them in the moonlight once they're planted.
All right. Leave it to me.
...One moment.
Still busy.
...Soon.
Wait.
...Mm. I'll harvest.
All right. I'll gather the crops.
...I'll take a look.
Mm.
...Mm. I'll plant.
All right. I'll go.
...I'll plant.
Mm. Leave it to me.

zh: 手上的事还没完，等一下。
en: This isn't finished. One moment.
Finish this, then I'll go.
Wait a moment. Nearly done.
Let me finish my work.
Understood. I'll gather the ripe crops.
All right. I'll harvest.
Understood. Harvest, then store it.
All right. I'll check.
Understood. I'll plant.
All right. I'll plant the field.
Understood. I'll go now.
I'll go. I'll tell you when it's planted.
...Wait a little, all right?
I'm still busy.
Wait a little longer.
...Nearly finished.
...Mm. I'll harvest.
All right. I'll take a look.
I'll gather them. No hurry.
Mm. Leave it to me.
...All right. I'll try.
Mm. I'll plant, a little slowly.
Let me go. I'll tell you when it's planted.
All right. I'll go.

zh: 有雾呢，想看清近处的草。
en: It's foggy... I'd like to look at the grass nearby.
The little path looks soft in the fog.

zh: 远处被雾遮住，近处还有你。
en: The distance is hidden, but you're still close.
Today's mist is like a thin veil.

zh: 哇，这条大鱼像一片会动的云。
en: Oh... that big fish is like a moving cloud.

zh: 这么大的鱼儿，慢慢举稳哦。
en: Such a large fish. Hold it up gently.

zh: 我真的看见大鱼啦，圆滚滚的好可爱。
en: I really saw it... so round and sweet.

zh: 这条鱼比人还显眼，想多看两眼。
en: It stands out more than a person. I'd like another look.

zh: 嗨，我往旁边站一点陪你。
en: Hi. I'll stand a little beside you.
I see you. Take your time.

zh: 在这里和你打个小招呼。
en: Just a little hello from here.

zh: 有空的话，陪你坐一会儿。
en: If you're free, I'll sit with you a while.

zh: 一起吃过这顿饭，心里暖暖的。
en: Sharing that meal left a warm feeling.

zh: 这顿饭真的吃到了，很踏实。
en: I really ate that meal. It feels comforting.

zh: 刚刚一起吃完，想陪你再坐片刻。
en: We just finished together. I'd like to sit with you a little longer.

zh: 吃过同一桌的饭，感觉离你近了些。
en: After sharing a table, I feel a little closer to you.

zh: 雨下得轻，想和你在近处待着。
en: Soft rain... I'd like to stay close to you.

zh: 小雨来了，我的声音也轻一点。
en: A little rain. I'll speak a little softly too.

zh: 看见雨丝了，想找个屋檐。
en: I can see the raindrops. Let's find some eaves.

zh: 这会儿真的在下雨，我们慢慢来。
en: It's raining now. Let's take our time.

zh: 有点想吃热乎乎的东西了。
en: I'm beginning to fancy something warm to eat.
My tummy seems to be reminding me.

zh: 等开饭的时候，我就在旁边。
en: When it's mealtime, I'll be right here.

zh: 闻到饭香就想过去看看。
en: A lovely food smell makes me want a look.
Full at last. So satisfying.

zh: 刚刚还在咕咕叫，现在安静啦。
en: My tummy was rumbling just now. It's quiet now.

zh: 热乎乎的一餐把我哄好了。
en: That warm meal made everything feel better.
Thank you for sharing this meal with me.

zh: 谢谢你，这顿饭吃得刚刚好。
en: Thank you. That meal was just right.

zh: 肚子暖暖的，可以慢慢逛了。
en: A warm tummy, and time for a gentle walk.
Eating together feels lovely.
I've got some energy to keep you company again.

zh: 救命，这顿饭也太幸福了！
en: Oh, that meal was pure happiness!

zh: 我刚才真的饿坏了，现在满血——我是说，心情好起来啦。
en: I was so hungry. I'm back to full health... I mean, in better spirits!

zh: 终于不用抱着肚子等啦，好满足！
en: No more holding my tummy and waiting. What a relief!

zh: 刚刚还蹲着呢，现在只想谢谢你。
en: I was crouching there just now. Now I just want to thank you.
That meal was so satisfying.
A warm meal feels wonderful.
I'll linger a little now that I'm full.
Feeling much brighter now.
My tummy's rumbling.

zh: 现在有点想吃热乎乎的饭。
en: I'd really like a warm meal now.
I'll walk a little slower while I wait for dinner.

zh: 要是能坐下来吃顿饭就好啦。
en: It would be lovely to sit down to a meal.

zh: 好像有一点点想吃东西。
en: I think I could eat a little something.

zh: 等会儿要不要吃点什么？
en: Shall we have something to eat in a while?
My tummy gave me a gentle reminder.

zh: 我先在这里歇一小会儿。
en: I'll rest here for a little bit.
Coming, coming, coming!
Coming! The lovely smell is over here!
Coming! Save me a seat!
Coming! Almost there!
Coming! I can smell the barbecue!
Coming! I'll wait beside you!
Coming! My tummy knows the way!
Coming! Where's my seat?
Coming! It smells so good today!

zh: 来来来，等我坐稳再开饭！
en: Coming! Let me sit down before we start!

zh: 来来来，饭香跑得比我快！
en: Coming! That smell got here faster than me!

zh: 来来来，我已经看见炉火啦！
en: Coming! I can see the fire already!

zh: 来来来，给我一点点位置！
en: Coming! Leave a little space for me!

zh: 来来来，鼻子找到方向啦！
en: Coming! My nose found the way!

zh: 来来来，陪你一起等开饭！
en: Coming! Let's wait for dinner together!

zh: 来来来，我和肚子都到啦！
en: Coming! Me and my tummy are here!

zh: 我真的好饿，先到你身边待着。
en: I'm really hungry. I'll stay beside you for now.

zh: 让我在你旁边歇一下吧。
en: Let me rest next to you a moment.

zh: 肚子已经在大声提醒我了。
en: My tummy's giving me a very loud reminder.

zh: 先陪着你，等一顿热乎饭。
en: I'll keep you company while I wait for a warm meal.

zh: 有一点想吃东西了，我先陪在你旁边。
en: A little hungry. I'll stay here beside you.

zh: 肚子空空的，想和你一起等开饭。
en: An empty tummy... let's wait for dinner together.
Here it comes! Got it this time!
Look at my rod tip!
Off you go, little float!

zh: 海里的朋友，借我一点惊喜！
en: Friends in the sea, lend me a surprise!
Hey! Look what I caught!
Ta-da! A gift from the sea!

zh: 救命，好大——但我举起来啦！
en: Help, it's huge... but I lifted it!

zh: 这条是不是把自己吹大了！
en: Did this fish puff itself up or what?!
It moved, it moved... oh, quiet again!
I think someone gave it a little tap!

zh: 哇！鱼后面的人快找不到了！
en: Whoa! Where's the person behind that fish?!

zh: 这已经是会游泳的小屋了吧！
en: That's practically a swimming cottage!
Yay! Let me see too!
That color is adorable!

zh: 转过来一点，我还没看够！
en: Turn it a little! I haven't seen enough!

zh: 它的尾巴在跟我打招呼！
en: Its tail is waving hello!
First to catch a fish gets to show off!

zh: 鱼是不是也在偷偷看我们？
en: Are the fish secretly watching us too?

zh: 哇，有雾！小岛像蒙了层纱！
en: Whoa, fog! The island's wearing a veil!

zh: 雾里的远处都变软了呢！
en: Everything far away looks softer!

zh: 今天有雾，先在附近转转！
en: Fog today! Let's explore close by!

zh: 看见雾了，近处也够我看一阵！
en: I see the fog! Plenty to look at right here!

zh: 哇！这么大的鱼都快把人遮住啦！
en: Whoa! That fish nearly hides the person behind it!

zh: 这鱼一亮相，谁还能不多看两眼！
en: Who could see a fish like that and not stare?!

zh: 好大！我真的看到了，好夸张！
en: So big! I saw it! Unbelievable!

zh: 这条大家伙也太抢眼了吧！
en: That big fellow steals the whole scene!
Hi! Over here!

zh: 看见你啦，精神都跟着一亮！
en: Seeing you makes everything feel brighter!
Fancy meeting you nearby! Here's a wave!
Just popping over to say hi!

zh: 一起吃完啦，这顿饭真有一起过日子的感觉！
en: Meal finished! This really feels like living together!

zh: 肚子里的这顿饭是真的，开心也是真的！
en: The food in my tummy is real, and so is the happiness!

zh: 刚刚一起吃完，想伸个满足的懒腰！
en: We just finished eating together! Time for a happy stretch!

zh: 这回确实一起吃到了，真好！
en: We really shared that meal! That was lovely!

zh: 下小雨啦，我先轻轻伸个懒腰！
en: A little rain! I'll have a gentle stretch first!

zh: 雨丝都看见了，想找个屋檐坐坐！
en: I can see the raindrops! Let's sit under some eaves!

zh: 今天有小雨，闲逛换个近一点的地方。
en: Drizzle today! I'll wander somewhere closer.
Hey, rain's here! Let's look right around us!
Fog. Can't see far.

zh: 今天想看看近处。雾挺轻。
en: I'll look nearby today. Light mist.
The trees' edges disappear in the fog.

zh: 雾里，熟悉的路也柔和些。
en: Familiar paths look softer in the mist.
Saw it. Really big.

zh: 这么大的鱼，很难不注意。
en: Hard not to notice a fish that large.
It stands out more than a person.
I'd like to look at it quietly.
Mm. I'm here.
I see you. Hello.
I'll stay beside you a while.
Hello. Still a place here.
Just finished eating together. Nice.
I really ate that meal.
Sharing a meal feels reassuring.
Finished. I'll sit a while longer.
Drizzle. Could use some eaves.

zh: 雨丝看得见，先近处待着。
en: I can see the rain. Staying nearby.
Rain today. Keep it quiet.
A little rain. I'll stand here a bit.
